objective: I can practice reading a daily schedule. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: A schedule card is posted near the learner's usual workspace, showing five labeled blocks in order for a typical weekday.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Describe one specific moment today when checking the schedule told you something you would not have known otherwise, such as how much of outdoor time was left.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Current-block identification: Correctly marks the block matching the actual moment at all three checks. | Next-block prediction: Correctly names the block that comes immediately after the current one at all three checks. | Recall of block order: Recalls at least four of the five block labels in the correct order from memory. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner design a six-block schedule card for a non-lesson day, such as a weekend, in the same now-and-next format, then check the card against what actually happens that day.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can practice reading a daily schedule. I will do one step at a time and check one result.

duration.sessionPattern: 5 minutes model, 5–7 minutes guided try, 10–15 minutes learner task, 5 minutes evidence and retry check
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: a pencil or marker
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: reading a daily schedule worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: A schedule card is posted near the learner's usual workspace, showing five labeled blocks in order for a typical weekday.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact reading a daily schedule decision or action.
Model move 2: Before reading the whole schedule, look only at the very first labeled block.
Model move 3: Check the schedule card at three different times today.

Model check: Current-block identification: Correctly marks the block matching the actual moment at all three checks. | Next-block prediction: Correctly names the block that comes immediately after the current one at all three checks. | Recall of block order: Recalls at least four of the five block labels in the correct order from memory.

resources.title: reading a daily schedule action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for reading a daily schedule.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-guided-card.

resources.title: reading a daily schedule coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: A schedule card is posted near the learner's usual workspace, showing five labeled blocks in order for a typical weekday.
Coach direction: Before reading the whole schedule, look only at the very first labeled block.
Learner prompt: Name the first labeled block on the schedule card, in the exact words printed on it.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: reading a daily schedule complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Check the schedule card at three different times today. Each time, find the block that matches what you are doing right now, mark it, and then name the block that comes right after it.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I found and marked the block that matched what I was doing at the first check.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I named the block that comes right after the marked block, using the card's printed order.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I repeated both steps at a second time of day.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I repeated both steps a third time, at least one hour after the second check.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: reading a daily schedule minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Describe one specific moment today when checking the schedule told you something you would not have known otherwise, such as how much of outdoor time was left.

Success checks: Current-block identification: Correctly marks the block matching the actual moment at all three checks. | Next-block prediction: Correctly names the block that comes immediately after the current one at all three checks. | Recall of block order: Recalls at least four of the five block labels in the correct order from memory.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: reading a daily schedule supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional reading a daily schedule condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Current-block identification: Correctly marks the block matching the actual moment at all three checks. | Next-block prediction: Correctly names the block that comes immediately after the current one at all three checks. | Recall of block order: Recalls at least four of the five block labels in the correct order from memory..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u05-l01-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
